description: This script automates uploading a local build to Google Compute Engine and optionally launching a device. It includes functions for SSH connection, artifact uploading, launching, and stopping CVD instances, with command-line argument parsing for configuration.

methods.name: gcloud_ssh
methods.description: Constructs an SSH command string for gcloud compute ssh with user, instance, and optional zone.

methods.name: upload_artifacts
methods.description: Uploads build artifacts to a Google Compute Engine instance by creating a tarball and transferring it via SSH.

methods.name: launch_cvd
methods.description: Launches a CVD (Android Emulator) instance on the remote machine with optional data image parameters.

methods.name: stop_cvd
methods.description: Stops the running CVD instance on the remote machine.

methods.name: __get_default_hostdir
methods.description: Retrieves the default host directory from environment variable 'ANDROID_HOST_OUT' or defaults to current directory.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses command-line arguments, stops existing CVD, uploads artifacts, and optionally launches a new CVD.
